How to read the files

Final family ID
Stable PyamilySeq identifier for the final reconciled family.
Family status
“Linked to original pangenome” means the final family includes a first-round family. “Novel family” means it has no first-round family member.
Original cluster IDs
Labels from the original clustering input that contributed to this family. These are the most useful field for tracing a family back to the original clusters.
Family category
Prevalence bin and reconciliation stage, such as extended_core_99. The stage is First, extended, combined, or only_Second; the suffix is its prevalence group.
Source lineage IDs
Internal stable IDs used to preserve exact provenance. They are identifiers, not biological annotations; use original cluster IDs for interpretation.
family_summary.tsv
One row per retained final family across the whole pangenome. It includes copy number and prevalence statistics. The lineage columns are provenance fields, not family names.
